title: Boat Trailer Winch Strap – Heavy-Duty with Hook 12000 lbs
descriptionHtml:
Pull the boat up onto the trailer with confidence

A worn or too weak winch strap is both unsafe and stressful when launching. You want to be able to trust that the strap holds the full weight.

Strong strap with a pulling capacity of 12000 lbs

The heavy-duty winch strap withstands up to 12000 lbs and has a sturdy hook. It fits most boat trailers and makes both hauling out and launching easier.

Features

  • Pulling capacity up to 12000 lbs
  • Sturdy metal hook
  • Hard-wearing strap that withstands heavy use
  • Fits most boat trailers
  • Also good for towing and emergency rescue

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
